## HOW TO RUN THIS

Runs SEPARATELY from the Master Orchestrator, in batches, whenever you want to top up your lead list.

1. Fill Apify API token (search 'YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN_HERE')
2. Fill your Sheet ID (search 'YOUR_SHEET_ID_HERE')
3. Edit the 'Target Cities' node - list whatever US cities you want to scrape
4. Click 'Start Scrape'
5. Apify's free plan gives monthly usage credit with no card required to start - watch your usage on apify.com if you scale up city count

This ONLY appends leads with no website. Anything that already has a website gets filtered out before it ever reaches your Sheet.

New rows land with Call Status EMPTY - which is exactly what the Master Orchestrator looks for as 'new, never called'.
